items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I was wondering when you were out of the band in the army who took your place? Emil Christian played trombone

ctx.x: I was wondering when you were out of the band in the army who took your place? Emil Christian played trombone only Christian that's right and uh did Christian make any
records in this country do you know? no no he did make some in uh London I don't believe they turned out any too well through no fault of his through no fault of Emil's

I have heard them and it seems to me he plays very close to your parts on them yes you must have listened very carefully to your records were there any other changes after Robinson came in? Signorelli came with us
